news.title: Gujjubhai Industries Limited Approves the Regularization of Sunil Veerayya Swamy as A Non-Executive Independent
news.body: Gujjubhai Industries Limited approved the regularization of Mr. Sunil Veerayya Swamy (DIN: 07617208) as a Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company in the proceedings of Extra-Ordinary General Meeting of the company held on 27th April, 2026.

news.title: New major risk - Shareholder dilution
news.body: The company's shareholders have been substantially diluted in the past year. Increase in shares outstanding: 194% This is considered a major risk. Shareholder dilution occurs when there is an increase in the number of shares on issue that is not proportionally distributed between all shareholders. Often due to the company raising equity capital or some options being converted into stock. All else being equal, if there are more shares outstanding then each existing share will be entitled to a lower proportion of the company's total earnings, thus reducing earnings per share (EPS). news.title: Sumuka Agro Industries Limited (BSE:532070) completed the acquisition of GUJJUBHAI FOODS PRIVATE Limited.
news.body:
Sumuka Agro Industries Limited (BSE:532070) agreed to acquire GUJJUBHAI FOODS PRIVATE Limited for INR 1.8 billion on August 14, 2023. The consideration consists of 13.81 million common equity of Sumuka Agro Industries Limited to be issued for common equity of GUJJUBHAI FOODS PRIVATE Limited. As part of consideration, an undisclosed value is paid towards common equity of GUJJUBHAI FOODS PRIVATE Limited. The transaction is subject to approval by regulatory board / committee. As of July 1, 2024 Bombay Stock Exchange approved the transaction. The expected completion of the transaction is October 1, 2024 to October 31, 2024.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.08 (vs ₹1.00 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.08 (up from ₹1.00 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹211.7m (up 24% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹7.70m (up 8.3% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.6% (down from 4.2% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 2% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 53% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.2% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk High level of non-cash earnings (69% accrual ratio).
